subject.title: fix(signal): detect native bot mentions in group gating

question: Should OpenClaw accept that Signal groups with `requireMention=true`, configured bot identity, and no text mention regex now enforce native mention gating instead of passing all group chatter through?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and proven, but the behavior can intentionally change existing upgraded Signal deployments, so a maintainer must own the compatibility policy before merge.

options.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
options.body: Merge with the documented upgrade behavior that native-capable Signal groups drop unmentioned chatter into bounded pending context.

options.title: Require A Transition Policy
options.body: Ask for an opt-in, migration, or clearer transition note if existing pass-through behavior must remain the default for some deployments.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Pause or close if configured Signal identity should not make native mention detection enforceable for existing groups.

recommendation.title: Accept Stricter Native Gating
recommendation.body: Merge with the documented upgrade behavior that native-capable Signal groups drop unmentioned chatter into bounded pending context.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent history on the shared mention-gating policy and is an official repository decision owner for compatibility-sensitive runtime behavior.
